headline_marked: 18-year-old student [[strangled by husband]] in Dhaka's Khilgaon
headline: 18-year-old student strangled by husband in Dhaka's Khilgaon
summary: Sanjida Akhter, a first-year college student, was found dead in her apartment. Her husband, a Foodpanda delivery rider, has been arrested and confessed to the crime.
details: An 18-year-old college student, Sanjida Akhter (also known as Maria), was allegedly strangled by her husband in Dhaka's Khilgaon area.
The victim was a first-year management student at Lalmatia Mohila College. Her body was recovered from a ground-floor apartment near Haji Mosque in South Goran.
Sanjida's family became concerned when she didn't answer her phone. Upon checking the house, they found her unconscious on the kitchen balcony floor with marks around her neck.
Police recovered the body and found a jute rope wrapped around her neck. The body has been sent to the Dhaka Medical College morgue for an autopsy.
The suspect, 21-year-old Saiful Islam, a Foodpanda delivery rider, was arrested shortly after the incident using technological surveillance.
During primary interrogation, Saiful allegedly confessed to killing his wife. Investigators suspect marital disputes involving his parents may have been the motive.
Sanjida's brother, Md Chan Mia, has filed a murder case with Khilgaon Police Station. Saiful has been produced before a court.
caption:
An 18-year-old college student was strangled to death by her husband in Dhaka's Khilgaon. The suspect has confessed to the crime.

An 18-year-old college student, Sanjida Akhter (also known as Maria), was allegedly strangled by her husband in Dhaka's Khilgaon area.

The victim was a first-year management student at Lalmatia Mohila College. Her body was recovered from a ground-floor apartment near Haji Mosque in South Goran.

Sanjida's family became concerned when she didn't answer her phone. Upon checking the house, they found her unconscious on the kitchen balcony floor with marks around her neck.

Police recovered the body and found a jute rope wrapped around her neck. The body has been sent to the Dhaka Medical College morgue for an autopsy.

The suspect, 21-year-old Saiful Islam, a Foodpanda delivery rider, was arrested shortly after the incident using technological surveillance.

During primary interrogation, Saiful allegedly confessed to killing his wife. Investigators suspect marital disputes involving his parents may have been the motive.

Sanjida's brother, Md Chan Mia, has filed a murder case with Khilgaon Police Station. Saiful has been produced before a court.
